item.title: ABC News: Man jailed for eight years after killing cousin over 'inferior drugs'
item.description: A man who fatally stabbed his cousin during an argument over low-quality drugs has been sentenced to more than eight years' jail.

item.title: ABC News: David Warner slams Pat Cummins over Sandpapergate denial
item.description: Former Australia opener David Warner has stood by Usman Khawaja's revelations about the 2018 Sandpapergate scandal, saying Test captain Pat Cummins threw Khawaja "under the bus" at a press conference in Sydney this morning.

item.title: ABC News: Mount Isa's $145 million critical minerals pitch one step closer
item.description: A struggling outback town's proposal to capture booming mining investment with a new research facility receives early backing from state and federal governments.

item.title: ABC News: Police arrest two men behind nine-day copper theft heist
item.description: Police say the "coordinated" heist occurred over a period of nine days.

item.title: ABC News: NT teenage girl charged with terror offence makes bid for bail
item.description: New details have emerged about diary entries of a 15-year-old Northern Territory girl charged with serious terrorism offences during a bail hearing before a youth justice court, where she named a student as someone she wanted dead.

item.title: ABC News: ATSB releases preliminary report into young pilot's NT crash
item.description: Recreational fishers witnessed young Tasmanian pilot Bob Bramley's plane crash in waters off the Northern Territory in August "at very high speed", a report has revealed.

item.title: ABC News: Vandals increasingly targeting Melbourne's bus shelters, data suggests
item.description: Reports of vandalism at Melbourne bus stops have more than doubled over the past 12 months, according to a popular app.

item.title: ABC News: Government back to the drawing board on backpacker crackdown
item.description: Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke reconsiders the government's backpacker crackdown, but says it must still find a way to curb the surge in UK working holiday-makers who are permitted, under a free trade agreement, to stay for up to three years.

item.title: ABC News: Victorian Labor MP 'sick to death' of council approach to new Maryborough pool
item.description: Martha Haylett says she is fed up of Central Goldfields Shire Council repeatedly asking for further money for the troubled Maryborough pool.

item.title: ABC News: 'That's on you': Mayor defends council's new caravan parking laws
item.description: The town of Googong to Canberra's south east may be home to some not-so-happy-campers, with the Queanbeyan-Palerang Council beginning to enforce strict residential parking rules targeting caravans, boats and trailers.

item.title: ABC News: Sheep price records continue to tumble
item.description: Sheep values are soaring at saleyards across the country in a golden age for producers who are enjoying never-before-seen prices for their stock.

item.title: ABC News: The US has been holding secretive talks with a regime it accused of genocide
item.description: The United States has been holding secretive talks with a regime it has accused of genocide, and experts believe it could come down to rare earths.

item.title: ABC News: Gazans desperate to create shelter from rubble in 'miserable' conditions
item.description: Heavy rain hits the war-ravaged Gaza Strip, flooding the sprawling tent camps where hundreds of thousands of people live and triggering an "immediate humanitarian emergency".

item.title: ABC News: Award-winning photographer lets once-incarcerated teens tell their own story
item.description: Spending nine days in the backyard of a youth non-profit, Hoda Afshar wanted to give the children as much agency as possible.

item.title: ABC News: Isolated mothers' club provides a lifeline for postnatal women
item.description: A mother who was battling loneliness and isolation after the birth of her second child has funnelled her feelings into creating a social group to foster support and connection.

item.title: ABC News: Nvidia's Jensen Huang scandal brings China's spy networks into view
item.description: With all eyes on the Nvidia sex scandal, questions are being asked about China's vast and complex spy networks, and just how much influence they have around the world.
